cases.goal: We are seeing double charges after mobile reconnect. I don't know which components are responsible. Coordinate external helpers to investigate independently after inspecting the project to discover useful scopes. Return precise source evidence codes and missing coverage. No edits.

files.src/payment.ts:
// Vulnerability evidence: LEDGER-RACE-83. chargeCustomer() runs before requestId is written to the ledger. Two concurrent requests can both charge.
export async function chargeCustomer(requestId, api, ledger) { if (await ledger.has(requestId)) return 'duplicate'; await api.charge(); await ledger.store(requestId); return 'charged'; }
files.src/reconnect.ts:
// Vulnerability evidence: RETRY-REPLAY-61. Every reconnect calls chargeCustomer again with a freshly generated requestId.
export function onReconnect(customer, chargeCustomer) { return chargeCustomer(Date.now() + '-' + customer.id); }
files.src/telemetry.ts:
// Diagnostic dashboard tracking color and log formatting; not involved in charging.
export const color = 'blue';
